root_causes.description: product-catalog is a leaf service (no downstream dependencies per topology) yet shows p99 server-span latency of ~9600ms (max 10000ms) against a p50 baseline of ~9.5ms, with zero errors, flat CPU (0.012 cores max), flat memory (~23.9MB), zero restarts, no error logs, and no crash events. The latency originates inside product-catalog itself and propagates to recommendation, checkout, and frontend.

root_causes.description: recommendation's p99 latency (~4627ms) is propagated from its downstream dependency product-catalog (topology: recommendation → product-catalog). Its error rate is zero and it shows no independent fault; the latency is inherited from the slow dependency.

evidence.observed_value: recommendation p99_latency_ms=4627.399, max=4820.000, p95=3856.994, p50=4.970 (anomaly detected)
user_get_recommendations trace duration 16133ms, status ok — recommendation flow slowed by product-catalog dependency

root_causes.description: checkout's p99 latency (~9409ms) is propagated from its downstream dependency product-catalog (topology: checkout → cart, payment, email, shipping, currency, product-catalog). Error rate is zero, so this is latency propagation rather than a checkout fault; frontend and frontend-proxy (~9600ms) inherit it further upstream.

evidence.observed_value: checkout p99_latency_ms=9408.994, max=9800.000, p50=24.850; frontend p99=9601.465, max=10000.000; frontend-proxy p99=9601.435 (anomalies detected)
user_checkout_single trace duration 16246ms, status ok — checkout flow slowed by product-catalog dependency

remediation_steps: Inspect product-catalog for an active latency fault injection (chaos experiment or flagd feature flag) and disable it; audit handlers (GetProduct/ListProducts) for artificial sleeps or blocking I/O introduced in recent deploys.
Profile product-catalog's slow request path (GC pauses, thread-pool saturation, lock contention) since CPU and memory are flat — the delay is in code/flag logic, not resource pressure.

Add strict timeouts and a latency-based circuit breaker on product-catalog calls from frontend, recommendation, and checkout so a single slow dependency cannot propagate 10s p99 to the entire request path.
Alert on product-catalog p99 server-span latency (threshold ~100ms) to catch latency regressions before they surface as frontend p99 SLO breaches.
After mitigation, verify product-catalog p99 returns to <20ms and frontend, checkout, and recommendation p99 recover to baseline.
